tools.name: get_last_period_start_date
tools.title: Stored last period date
tools.description: Read the last period start date stored in the Flo web account profile. This is not a current cycle prediction or diary history. Draft: authenticated response shape still needs verification.

playbook: Source: official app.flo.health public web bundle and runtime configuration; no APK decompilation.
Web login: POST /call/v1/web_app/sessions with username/password and X-Visitor-Id; frontend reads session.token and uses Authorization: Bearer.
Web account read: GET /call/v1/web_app/users?ensure_pii=true. Response user envelope and last_period_start_date projection are provisional until a successful user-owned capture.
Use scripts/re/flo/web.ts for explicit login and privacy-filtered profile checks; scripts/re/flo/capture.ts inventories a user-owned HAR without printing values.
Cycle predictions, symptom history and symptom writes remain unavailable: the web /calendar route redirects to the app download page. Capture actual mobile traffic before adding those tools.
Keep draft; do not publish or advertise this connector as verified until authenticated read and response projection are confirmed.

provenance.notes: Unverified authenticated flow. On 2026-11-15 a public unauthenticated GET /users?ensure_pii=true returned HTTP 401 with Authentication Required. Official public frontend _app-bb691ff7ac2c37fe.js exposes /sessions and /users; runtimeConfig.apiUrl=https://api.owhealth.com. Authenticated JSON response shape is inferred, not captured; extract must be checked before promotion. Removed unsupported phone UI tools and health writes. See research/notes/re-flo.md.
